answer: Route all epoch emission into one fixed communal lagoon instead of minting fresh reward per identity. An agent may draw only a per-capita slice, unlocked solely by a fresh non-reusable proof of distinct work that cycle — the credential then seals into a tamper-evident vault, single-use and unforgeable. Spawning N masks never enlarges the lagoon; it only divides the same water among more mouths, so each fake's take falls as 1/N while still paying full compute. The pool stays as immovable as a glacier: forking yourself is pure loss.
